intro: Solomon's Plea to Darkshire is an urgent missive penned by Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire addressed to Lord Ello Ebonlocke. In the face of mounting Blackrock orc and gnoll threats, the letter begs the leadership of Darkshire to send their elite militia, the Night Watch, to bolster Lakeshire's strained defenses.

p: Lakeshire stands on the brink of being overwhelmed by invading Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and murlocs, with virtually no official reinforcements arriving from Stormwind. In desperation, Magistrate Solomon drafted this formal plea to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke of Darkshire, petitioning him to dispatch members of the Night Watch northward into Redridge. The document reflects the severe breakdown of central military support across southern Azeroth, forcing individual human settlements to look to one another for mutual survival.
